authority_rule: Session validity permits consideration of a RUN, never implicit execution authority.
budget_rule: Every atomically reserved RUN_ID counts, including blocked/failed. SUM cumulative; ACTIVE_COUNT concurrency; ACTIVE_SUM memory. Unknown consumption not refunded.

EXPERIMENTAL_REUSABLE.fault_injection: only when separately authorized per RUN
EXPERIMENTAL_REUSABLE.purpose: controlled development, failure discovery and bounded named fault injection

revocation_rule: Blocks future admission at authoritative boundary; in-flight stop requires separately proven actuator and ownership semantics.
run_failure_rule: FAIL, safe prestate block, bounded timeout with proven cleanup or negative result does not by itself terminate session. Ambiguous run permits continuation only after independent isolation proof; otherwise QUARANTINED.

transitions.guard: issuer-authenticated session authority; exact immutable bindings, numeric budgets, source/freeze/policy and owner verified; qualified store healthy
authority integrity or bound source/policy mismatch
after each terminal RUN, continuation check proves unchanged bindings, budget, owner/resource cleanup, healthy evidence/claim store and no foreign mutation; next RUN has fresh IDs and authority
session lifetime reached; no new admission
max_runs consumed, explicit revoke, or owner termination
session-level invariant violated, claim/effect uncertainty contaminates host/session, evidence corruption, foreign ownership, protected source/policy mutation or host exclusivity compromise
